$comment: Single source of truth for permission names (roles.permitions). Read by the permission matrix screen, the role editor and the seed scripts. Add new permissions here.

permissions.name: access_general_settings
permissions.title: Manage users, role assignments and system settings

permissions.name: view_security_admin
permissions.title: View users, roles, permission matrix and settings (read-only)

permissions.name: confirm_role_changes
permissions.title: Confirm permission-matrix changes proposed by another administrator

permissions.name: manage_security_settings
permissions.title: Change password, lockout, 2FA and session policy

permissions.name: view_system_health
permissions.title: View system health, backups and the e-mail / SMS log

permissions.name: manage_delegations
permissions.title: Set up or end approval delegations for other people

permissions.name: view_master_data
permissions.title: View chart of accounts, funding sources, projects, fiscal years and tax rates

permissions.name: manage_chart_of_accounts
permissions.title: Create and change GL accounts and cost centres

permissions.name: manage_fiscal_years
permissions.title: Create fiscal years and choose the current year

permissions.name: manage_tax_rates
permissions.title: Create and change dated tax rates

permissions.name: confirm_tax_rates
permissions.title: Confirm tax and statutory rates against official RRA / RSSB sources

permissions.name: create_department
permissions.title: Create and change departments and department heads

permissions.name: manage_approval_workflows
permissions.title: Manage approval workflows and approval limits

permissions.name: manage_finance_settings
permissions.title: Change finance controls (budget control, tolerances, thresholds)

permissions.name: manage_procurement_settings
permissions.title: Manage document numbering, procurement categories and units

permissions.name: view_budgets
permissions.title: View budgets, utilisation and budget reports

permissions.name: override_budget
permissions.title: Override an insufficient budget balance (reason required, flagged in reports)

permissions.name: manage_procurement_plan
permissions.title: Prepare and submit annual procurement plans

permissions.name: manage_suppliers
permissions.title: Register suppliers, contacts, bank details and documents

permissions.name: approve_suppliers
permissions.title: Approve supplier registrations and bank-detail changes

permissions.name: manage_rfqs
permissions.title: Create and send RFQs, record quotations

permissions.name: manage_contracts
permissions.title: Create, submit and terminate procurement contracts

permissions.name: view_purchase_orders
permissions.title: View purchase orders and goods received notes

permissions.name: manage_purchase_orders
permissions.title: Create, submit, send and close purchase orders

permissions.name: receive_goods
permissions.title: Record goods received notes (full / partial, inspection)

permissions.name: authorize_over_receipt
permissions.title: Accept deliveries above the ordered quantity (within tolerance)

permissions.name: manage_inventory
permissions.title: Manage warehouses, items and stock adjustments

permissions.name: export_procurement
permissions.title: Export procurement plans, purchase orders and reports

permissions.name: manage_invoices
permissions.title: Record, correct and submit supplier invoices

permissions.name: resolve_invoice_exceptions
permissions.title: Resolve three-way match and duplicate exceptions

permissions.name: export_invoices
permissions.title: Export invoices, vouchers and payment reports

permissions.name: view_treasury
permissions.title: View bank and cash accounts, receipts, payments and transfers

permissions.name: manage_bank_accounts
permissions.title: Create and change bank and cash accounts

permissions.name: manage_treasury
permissions.title: Record receipts, cash payments and inter-account transfers

permissions.name: approve_treasury
permissions.title: Approve receipts, transfers and payment releases

permissions.name: prepare_bank_reconciliation
permissions.title: Import statements and prepare bank reconciliations

permissions.name: export_treasury
permissions.title: Export bank, cash and reconciliation reports

permissions.name: view_payroll_details
permissions.title: View payroll detail and all payslips

permissions.name: manage_salaries
permissions.title: Edit salary structures, allowances and deductions

permissions.name: manage_payroll_settings
permissions.title: Configure PAYE bands and statutory contributions

permissions.name: export_payroll
permissions.title: Export payroll register, bank file and deduction schedules

permissions.name: manage_fixed_assets
permissions.title: Register assets, transfers, maintenance and verification

permissions.name: approve_fixed_assets
permissions.title: Approve asset capitalisation and register changes

permissions.name: request_asset_transfer
permissions.title: Request asset transfers and disposals for own department

permissions.name: view_journals
permissions.title: View journal entries, GL and trial balance

permissions.name: manage_journals
permissions.title: Prepare manual, recurring and reversal journals

permissions.name: export_ledger
permissions.title: Export the GL, journals and trial balance

permissions.name: view_financial_reports
permissions.title: View financial statements and management reports

permissions.name: export_reports
permissions.title: Export financial statements and reports (Excel / PDF)

permissions.name: delete_employee_documents
permissions.title: Delete employee documents (staff can never delete their own)

permissions.name: manage_leave_policy
permissions.title: Manage leave types, public holidays and entitlement rules

permissions.name: manage_appraisals
permissions.title: Manage appraisal templates and cycles, finalise results

permissions.name: approve_or_reject_request
permissions.title: Approve or reject petty cash requests
